candidate_independent_field.name: q(a,t)
candidate_independent_field.nature: material vector displacement, not native Euler degree of freedom

model_limits.Maxwell_free: E=-zeta qdot, B=zeta curl q, zeta^2= rho_d/eps0 =mu0 K
model_limits.Cartan_torsion: fixed u_a and Weitzenbock gauge: F=kappa u_a dtheta^a=dA, hence dF=0

optional_not_derived.magnetooptic: Omega=beta B is an unverified constitutive relation

blindness_policy: No target masses, c, G, alpha, observed EM optical observables may be fit using held-out validation families. c is calibrated explicitly only in reference Maxwell-form test.
